mapper.select: SELECT A.MENU_ID,A.PARENT_MENU_ID,A.ROUTE_NAME,A.MENU_NAME,A.MENU_TYPE,A."PATH",A."RANK",A.REMARK,A.HIDE,A.STATUS,A.ADMIN_FLAG ,CASE WHEN A.PARENT_MENU_ID = '-1' THEN '根目录' ELSE B.MENU_NAME END PARENT_MENU_NAME FROM A1MFG.SYS_MENU_LIST A LEFT JOIN A1MFG.SYS_MENU_LIST B ON A.PARENT_MENU_ID = B.MENU_ID

SELECT A.*, CASE WHEN A.PARENT_MENU_ID = '-1' THEN '根目录' ELSE B.MENU_NAME END PARENT_MENU_NAME FROM( SELECT MENU_ID,PARENT_MENU_ID,ROUTE_NAME,MENU_NAME,MENU_TYPE,"PATH","RANK",REMARK,HIDE,STATUS,ADMIN_FLAG FROM A1MFG.SYS_MENU_LIST WHERE MENU_ID = #{menuId} ) A LEFT JOIN A1MFG.SYS_MENU_LIST B ON A.PARENT_MENU_ID = B.MENU_ID
